meta.name: Return to Sabaody
meta.description: Dos años han pasado desde que los Sombrero de Paja fueron forzosamente separados, y se han vuelto a juntar en Sabaody más fuertes y aún más comprometidos en la continuación de su viaje.

videos.title: Two Years Later
videos.overview: Two years after the Summit War, the Straw Hat crew finally returns to Sabaody. However, the archipelago has changed, and with dangerous pirates lurking around in droves, their departure to the New World may not go as smoothly as hoped.

videos.title: Island of New Beginnings
videos.overview: Luffy, in disguise, crosses paths with the fake Luffy, and the imposter finds himself on the receiving end of a mysterious power. Meanwhile, Sentomaru and the Marines have yet again amassed a team of Pacifistas.

videos.title: Dive, Dive, Dive!
videos.overview: After two long years and one chaotic afternoon, the Straw Hats are finally ready to renew their voyage. However, before they can set off to Fishman Island, they must contend with a massive Marine force determined to stop them.
